Common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

CookieConsent.message: We only use necessary cookies to keep you logged in - no advertising or tracking cookies.
CookieConsent.necessaryBody: Keeps you logged in and remembers this choice. Can't be turned off - the site doesn't work without them.
CookieConsent.analyticsBody: Sets a cookie (velvetine_visitor_id) to count unique visits, so we can see how Velvetine is used. Off by default - removed immediately if you turn it back off.

Install.iosInstructions: Tap the share icon in your browser and choose "Add to Home Screen".

AccountActions.deleteConfirm: This permanently removes your profile and can't be undone. Are you sure?

Home.heroTitle: A place for people who know what they want.
Home.heroSubtitle: Velvetine shows your tier openly — and lets you choose who you're seen by. No swiping in the dark. No guessing who someone really is.
Home.tiersTitle: Five tiers. You choose your visibility.
Home.tiersSubtitle: Your membership tier shows as a badge on your profile — no guessing games about who you're meeting. The highest tiers require an application, not just a card.
Home.step1Body: Some tiers require approval, not just payment.
Home.step2Body: Toggle which tiers show up in your own feed — and who sees you.
Home.step3Body: Verified profiles, real conversations — before any swiping.

Register.title: Apply for membership
Register.subtitle: You must be at least 18. The details below are used to set up your profile.
Register.consentText: I explicitly consent to my gender and who I'm looking for (which can reveal sexual orientation) being processed to match me with other members. Never shared with advertisers or other third parties.
Register.termsAcknowledgement: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>terms</terms> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
Register.errorSeekingRequired: Choose at least one option for who you're looking for.
Register.errorConsentRequired: You need to consent to the processing of gender/who you're looking for to continue.

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
ForgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email address you registered your account with, and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.defaultMessage: If an account exists with that email address, we've sent a reset link.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.invalidLink: This link is missing a valid code.

EmailVerification.invalidLink: This link is missing a valid code.
EmailVerification.bannerText: Confirm your email address to unlock the browse feed.
EmailVerification.verifiedRequiredBody: We sent a link to your email address when you registered. Click it to unlock the browse feed.

Dashboard.noTier: No tier chosen yet — payment and tier selection are coming in the next step.
Dashboard.incognitoBody: Browse without appearing in others' feed. Included from the Select tier and up.
Dashboard.incognitoLocked: Requires the Select tier or higher.
Dashboard.notificationsBody: Get notified when you get a new message or match - works even when Velvetine isn't open. Requires installing the app on iPhone.
Dashboard.notificationsDenied: Blocked in your browser - change it in your browser settings to turn on.
Dashboard.hardFiltersBody: Your search preferences (height, body type, hair color) now filter out non-matches instead of just sorting them lower. Included from the Reserved tier and up. Set them on your profile.
Dashboard.boostBody: Show at the top of everyone's feed for 30 minutes. Included from the Select tier, once per day.
Dashboard.boostCooldown: Already used today, try again tomorrow
Dashboard.boostLocked: Requires the Select tier or higher.

Store.title: Store
Store.subtitle: Purchasable frames for your profile photo - one-time purchase, not included in your tier. Visible to anyone who sees your profile.
Store.purchased: Done! Your new frame is ready to use.

Pricing.title: Pricing and tiers
Pricing.subtitle: What each membership tier actually gives you - not just a price.
Pricing.requiresApplication: Requires an approved application (approved instantly if the account is in good standing)

StoreInfo.title: Store
StoreInfo.subtitle: Purchasable frames for your profile photo - one-time purchase, separate from your membership tier. Visible to anyone who sees your profile.

Upgrade.title: Choose your tier
Upgrade.subtitle: Switch or upgrade anytime. Prices in SEK per month.
Upgrade.applyNoteLabel: Feel free to say why you're applying for this tier (optional)
Upgrade.applyNotePlaceholder: A couple of lines is plenty...
Upgrade.upgraded: Done! Your new tier is active.
Upgrade.paymentFailedBody: Your latest payment failed - most likely a card issue. Update your payment method to keep your tier.

Profile.title: Edit profile
Profile.subtitle: This is what others see about you in the browse feed.
Profile.bioPlaceholder: Write a few lines about yourself...
Profile.preferencesSubtitle: Completely private — only you see this. Helps the system find profiles that fit you better, without affecting or excluding anyone else.
Profile.preferencesPrivateNote: 🔒 Never shown to anyone, not even people you match with.
Profile.promptsSubtitle: Up to three answers show in the browse feed.
Profile.photosSubtitle: Up to 6 photos. The first one becomes your main photo.
Profile.maxPhotos: Max 6 photos — remove one to add another.
Profile.previewTitle: This is how your profile looks to others
Profile.exportBody: Get everything you've added to Velvetine in a file (JSON) - your right to data portability under GDPR.
Profile.verificationBody: Upload a current selfie of yourself - our team manually compares it to your profile photos. A verified profile gets a checkmark next to the name, so others know you are who you say.
Profile.verificationFailed: Couldn't be verified - try a clearer photo where your face is clearly visible.

Showcase.title: Show off a little
Showcase.subtitle: Car, boat, plane, house, pet — show what you're proud of. Max 6 things.
Showcase.maxReached: Max 6 things — remove one to add another.

Discover.noMoreProfiles: No more profiles right now — check back later.
Discover.matchNotice: You both liked each other! You can now chat under "My matches".
Discover.blurredNotice: Unlock with this tier or higher
Discover.swipedNotice: Thanks! You'll find them in your list if it's a match.

Likes.title: Who likes you
Likes.lockedBody: See who's already liked you - without having to browse to find them. Included from the Entry tier and up.
Likes.empty: No one has liked you yet.
Likes.matchNotice: You both liked each other! You can now chat under "My matches".

Visitors.title: Profile visitors
Visitors.lockedBody: See everyone who's visited your profile, not just those who liked you. Included from the Premier tier.
Visitors.empty: No one has visited your profile yet.

Chat.inactive: This conversation is no longer active.
